free_tier.stated: After signing up for an account in the API Console you are granted credits to test the API for free; the platform announcement adds 'Users receive free credits every month, enough for hundreds of predictions'. A launch offer gave USD 2,000 in credits to every company and USD 100 to every academic for the first two weeks. The published price is 'from as little as $0.025 a prediction'.
free_tier.notes: The exact credit amount, its monthly renewal window and the price beyond the credits are not stated in the public pages read; the USD 2,000 and USD 100 grants were a two-week launch offer.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a biomolecular prediction, not a stored object

retention.stated: Default retention is 7 days after a run reaches a terminal state, with a minimum of 1 hour and a maximum of 14 days; the standard policy deletes data 30 days after a run starts and stops active runs at that limit. Results must be downloaded to the user's own storage.
retention.notes: The 30-day limit is counted from the run start; the configurable per-workspace window is 7 days by default and caps at 336 hours.

egress.terms: Result artifacts are fetched through time-limited download URLs with a url_expires_at timestamp; a public share link needs no key, an email-restricted share link needs a verified Boltz OAuth email. No egress price, allowance or metering term is published.

interface_detail: REST endpoints under https://api.boltz.bio/compute/v1 driven by the boltz-api CLI, a Python SDK and a TypeScript SDK; a CLI device-code login obtains an OAuth token and API keys are passed in the x-api-key header.
tooling: the boltz-api CLI installed from install.boltz.bio, the Python or TypeScript SDK, or any HTTP client sending x-api-key; agents use first-party plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI
chaining: A hosted prediction API for structure, affinity, ADME and molecular design work whose results are downloaded to the user's own storage, so multi-step pipelines need a separate record for durable state.

limits.value: Account signup with email verification is required: the console config sets REQUIRE_VERIFIED_EMAIL true and CONSOLE_SIGNUP_ENABLED true, and the Lab request-access form asks for full name, email, organization name and team size
data is deleted 30 days after a run starts, active runs are stopped at that limit, and the configurable retention window is 7 days by default with a 14-day maximum
a workspace spending limit is a lifetime cap in milli-USD; a request that does not fit remaining headroom is rejected with workspace_spending_limit_reached

binding_note: A verified account is needed before any credit or paid run can start; the credit amount and the spending cap are only reachable once the signup and email gate is passed.

identity_cost.detail: The Lab request-access form asks for full name, email, organization name, organization type and team size and states 'Use your company or institution email to receive additional free credits'; the login offers Google or email sign-in and email verification is required. The API is reachable with an account API key or a Google OAuth session; a card is not stated for the signup credit and no phone number or ID document is requested.

reliability_note: Output data is automatically deleted at the retention deadline and download URLs can expire before that deadline; a lifetime workspace spending limit can reject a job once its headroom is used.
confidence_note: The signup credit, the price and the monthly credit claim are quoted from the vendor's API docs, launch announcement and Lab FAQ read on 2026-11-24; the identity fields are quoted from the Lab request-access and login pages, and retention from the API docs, the same day.

notes: The credit amount is not published; the price beyond credits is stated only as 'from as little as $0.025 a prediction', and the USD 2,000 and USD 100 grants were a two-week launch promotion. Signup requires a verified email and the request-access form favours a company or institution email for additional credits. A test-mode key runs the full lifecycle for free with synthetic results. The Lab platform record and the API record are separate tiers of the same provider.
